title: Tech Hub Launch Event
description: The long-awaited Tech Hub officially opens its doors, moved from Wednesday to Friday after a delay in final wiring inspections. Expect demo booths, free swag, and a keynote from the IT Services director.

title: Student Union Elections
description: Postponed from earlier this month pending a review of the voter roll, SRC elections are back on the calendar. Polling booths open campus-wide from 8am to 6pm.

title: Library Late-Night Study Jam
description: Free coffee, quiet floors, and extended IT support to celebrate the now-permanent 24/7 library hours. Runs straight through to sunrise.
